skill.name: thinking-deeply
skill.description: Engages structured analysis to explore multiple perspectives and context dependencies before responding. Use when users ask confirmation-seeking questions, make leading statements, request binary choices, or when feeling inclined to quickly agree or disagree without thorough consideration.
skill.summary: Guides assistants to reframe questions, compare perspectives, and give context-aware recommendations before answering.
skill.author: brunoasm

content.value_statement: Quick agreement can hide weak assumptions and missing context. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured analysis before recommending a path.
actual_capabilities: Reframes confirmation questions into broader investigations.
Identifies assumptions embedded in user requests.
Compares several valid perspectives before recommending an answer.
Highlights context factors that can change the best choice.
Guides responses away from reflexive agreement or rejection.
Provides a structured format for nuanced recommendations.
limitations: Does not fetch current facts or verify claims with external sources.
Does not execute code, inspect files, or modify systems.
Can make simple answers longer when the question needs only a direct reply.
Depends on the assistant recognizing when deeper analysis is useful.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Technical Choices
use_cases.description: Compare frameworks, tools, or architectures with clear trade-offs and context factors.

use_cases.title: Improve Product Decisions
use_cases.description: Review feature, roadmap, or strategy questions before committing to one direction.

use_cases.title: Challenge Assumptions
use_cases.description: Surface hidden premises and alternative interpretations in research or planning discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Should I choose option A or option B? Reframe the decision and compare the trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Test My Assumption
prompt_templates.prompt: I think this approach is clearly best. Examine the assumption and show when it may fail.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Technical Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a technical direction by comparing team fit, complexity, maintenance, and delivery risk.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Decision Framework
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a decision framework for this strategic choice, including alternatives, context dependencies, and a qualified recommendation.

output_examples.input: Is React better than Vue for my project?
output: The better question is which framework fits your team, product scope, and delivery timeline.
React may fit complex applications with experienced teams and hiring needs.
Vue may fit faster onboarding, smaller teams, and more opinionated structure.
The recommendation depends on team experience, project size, timeline, and maintenance plans.

output_examples.input: Should we use microservices because they are modern?
output: Modern is not the main decision factor. The key question is whether your system needs independent services.
Microservices help with team autonomy and independent scaling, but add operational complexity.
A modular monolith can be stronger for small teams, early products, and simpler deployment.
Choose microservices only when the organizational and scaling benefits justify the added cost.

best_practices: Use the skill for decisions with real trade-offs or hidden assumptions.
Provide project goals, constraints, and audience details for better recommendations.
Ask for a final recommendation after the skill explores alternatives.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to avoid direct answers when facts are already clear.
Do not treat every option as equal when evidence strongly favors one path.
Do not omit the user's real constraints from the analysis.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides the assistant to pause, reframe the question, compare perspectives, and give a context-aware recommendation.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it for confirmation questions, binary choices, leading statements, and decisions with important trade-offs.

faq.question: Does it use external services?
faq.answer: No. It is a prompt-only skill and does not call APIs, run commands, or access files.

faq.question: Can it provide a direct answer?
faq.answer: Yes. It still gives a recommendation after it explains the main perspectives and context dependencies.

faq.question: Will it work with Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it useful outside software topics?
faq.answer: Yes. It can support product, research, writing, and planning decisions that need careful reasoning.
